responsibility: This file is the C implementation side of NDS32 builtins and intrinsic expansion. It registers the target-specific builtin functions exposed through nds32_intrinsic.h, checks builtin argument forms and constant ranges, converts arguments into legal RTL operands, and emits the corresponding instruction patterns from nds32-intrinsic.md, including system-register operations, cache/control primitives, DSP/vector builtins, and unaligned load/store helpers. It is therefore the bridge from front-end builtin calls to target RTL generation and diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/config/nds32/nds32-intrinsic.md, this C source is the procedural builtin side: it registers NDS32 intrinsic builtins, validates and canonicalizes their arguments, and invokes the generated md expanders/insns, rather than declaring the RTL patterns themselves.
